method.neck: World-space area of corresponding deformed material rings (polygon vector area) on the continuous torso, sampled from withers to poll. Standing 1 s, grazing 4 s, return 4 s at 60 Hz. Half = closest rising graze blend to 0.5. Range covers every frame. Unit m². Preceding-ring spacing uses world-space centroid distance divided by the same station pair’s neutral distance.
method.mane: Distance of each clay lock root centroid to its neutral nearest surface material point, carried by the same triangle and barycentric coordinates, LOD 0. Values include neutral embed depth.
method.gait: Ten wall-clock seconds at 60 Hz, flat floor, LOD 0. Walk with 1×, 0.45×, 1.8×, 0.7× and 1× simulation rate; includes curved walking and centaur Turn. Stop at second 9. Graze trial from rest, hold and return. Additional walk-to-graze-to-walk trial changes actions at wall seconds 2 and 7. Each stance begins at the first supported frame, ends on swing. Compare every neutral sole-patch vertex against its position at touchdown. Includes action changes.
method.habitat: Each animal starts at the real habitat origin for seven independent 60 Hz trials. Walk for the indicated duration then graze (unicorn) or stand (centaur) for five seconds. Stance drift follows every sole vertex; clearances sample the sole centre against both the live terrainHeight function and the piecewise planar rendered ground. Muzzle clearance is the lowest vertex relative to terrain beneath that vertex in the final second.
method.pivots: Fore chain shoulder/elbow/carpus/fetlock/hoof. Hind chain hip/stifle/hock/fetlock/hoof. Positive offset is anterior in the body sagittal plane. Inversion counts use 5 mm allowance; elbow/hock expected posterior, carpus/stifle anterior. Stage 1B fetlock and hoof are landmarks on one rigid cannon. Distances are evaluated after world scaling, including previous anisotropic body scaling.
